questions.prompt: The manager gave the two teams different stories about the new timetable. The teams argued with each other instead of questioning him together.

questions.prompt: The club leader gave the two groups different rules so that they would remain separated and would not challenge him together.
questions.promptZh: 學會領袖向兩個小組訂立不同規則，使他們保持分裂，無法共同質疑他。
